gloss: gift received; something given to one

definitions.gloss: something received as a gift; a present one was given
definitions.explanation: A thing someone gave you, seen from the receiver's side: food, sweets or goods that came as a present rather than being bought. Often used when passing such a thing on or offering it to a guest.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧もらい{物|もの}です。
もらい{物|もの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧。
examples.english: Someone gave us these sweets; please help yourself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧もらい{物|もの}で、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧もの⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: Most of the dishes in our house were gifts; we bought very few ourselves.

notes:
Formed from the stem of ⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to receive) and ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing). Also written {貰|もら}い{物|もの}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- もらい{物|もの}です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: it's something we were given, but… (said when offering it to a guest)
- もらい{物|もの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おすそ{分|わ}け: sharing part of a gift with others
- もらい{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to receive a lot of gifts

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頂|いただ}き{物|もの}: the humble, more polite version, used when the giver is someone to be respected
- ⟦{贈|おく}り{物|もの}→贈り物：01343_okurimono⟧: a present seen from the giver's side, or a present in general
